name: io.github.AccelByte/ags-api-mcp-server
title: AGS API
description: Stateless MCP server for AccelByte Gaming Services APIs with OpenAPI integration

studio.description: Shared Cloud — your AccelByte studio namespace (studio portion of your studio-game identifier)

game.description: Shared Cloud — your AccelByte game namespace (game portion of your studio-game identifier)

private_cloud_url.description: Private Cloud — your Private Cloud base host only, e.g. mygame.accelbyte.io (no https:// prefix, no trailing slash)

namespace.description: Private Cloud — your AccelByte namespace (typically studio-game)
